scientific_integrity: Complete analytical proof and standalone finite diagnostics are supplied. Historical priority is a best-knowledge assessment; not all classical radial-projection papers were readable in full.
scientific_limitations: No weighted-edge, non-tree, nonzero-center or unanchored-seminorm conclusion; the sharp global coefficient is a supremum and is not attained by any distinct finite input pair.
scientific_scope: Unweighted finite rooted trees, real signals, centered Euclidean radius-R balls with R>0, anchored tree-variation norm.
title: Sharp rooted-tree variation sensitivity of Euclidean ball projection
